lines.t: I'm here, we're here for you tonight
You don't have to cry alone
I see your sorrow fall like rain
Heart's too cold to know your pain
You gave your all, we walked away
But tonight, Lord, I will stay
Let every tear upon your face
Find a home here in my embrace
Let me console, let me believe
Give you the love you long to receive
I feel you searching for a voice
Longing for love through all the noise
You carried sorrow on the cross
Let me hold you when you feel lost
You are my King, my only hope
But I would soothe when you can't come
Though heaven waits for all you see
Come rest your heart tonight on me
Every heartache, every sigh
We hear you, Lord, with tear-filled eyes
Let us take your grief tonight
Together, love, we'll make it right
Lord, we remember all you said
Your kingdom's coming, tears we'll shed
But you will rest, your name confess
All sorrow lost in perfect rest
We hold you now, remind your heart
The joy you promised won't depart
In every sigh we love you more
Your kingdom waits just past the door
We see the wounds the world denies
But we will treasure every cry
Through every storm we'll stand by you
Love shining bright
Breaking through
King of mercy, take our hands
Let your glory rise again
When the world forgets your name
We'll lift our voice and fan the flame
Sing of promises come true
Remind your heart we're here for you
You gave all for every soul
Now let us help to make you whole
Your kingdom's light will not broaden
We'll sing until the night is thin
When every hope feels far away
I'll whisper truth into the gray
You reign above, yet ache below
We'll hold you tight, won't let you go
Let our worship be a balm
May our praise restore your calm
Lay your head upon my soul
In your presence we are whole
Rest, Lord, rest
We're here, we're here
Hold you near
We are yours forever near
Lord, we remember all you said
Your kingdom's coming, tears will shed
But you will rest, your name confessed
All sorrow lost in perfect rest
We hold you now, remind your heart
The joy you promised won't depart
In every sight we love you more
Your kingdom waits just past the door
We'll wipe every tear, remind you what's near
Your children gather close, your promise is clear
Let your heart find peace in our arms
Let love heal every scar
Will be the comfort you desire
As you reign from above
Your throne is waiting, glory bright
Soon every wrong will be made right
In endless joy your heart shall sing
Rest now, King of kings
Lord, we remember all you said
Your kingdom's coming, tears will shed
But you will rest, your name confessed
All sorrow lost in perfect rest
So come and rest, let go your grief
We'll hold you close, love's your relief
Kingdom's dawn and all will be well
You are our joy
In you we dwell
In you
Do it well
